products.title: B1304 P100 Filter
products.body_html:
The B1304 P100 Filter is a NIOSH Certified filter designed for use with the iEvac® E500 Escape Hood. Delivering greater than 99.97% filtration efficiency, it provides reliable protection against biological agents, toxic powders, aerosols, and particulates, making it an essential safeguard in industrial and emergency environments.

Featuring a universal screw-in connection, the B1304 is easy to replace and can be mounted on either side of the hood for maximum comfort and visibility. With its certified performance, reusable design, and long shelf life, this P100 filter ensures dependable respiratory protection whenever it’s needed most.

products.title: B1304-4 | Pack of 4 P100 Filters
products.body_html:
The B1304-4 P100 Filter Pack provides certified P100-level protection against hazardous particulates, toxic powders, aerosols, and biological agents with a filtration efficiency greater than 99.97%. Designed for use with the iEvac® E500 Escape Hood, these filters deliver trusted NIOSH-certified performance in industrial and emergency settings.

This convenient 4-pack ensures continuous readiness, giving facilities an economical way to maintain reliable respiratory protection when it’s needed most.

products.title: B1305 Riot Control Canister
products.body_html:

Its advanced P100 filter ensures greater than 99.97% efficiency, while the reusable design and universal NATO Din 40 connection provide a 10-year shelf life and reliable performance in high-risk scenarios.

Paired with the E600 military grade gas mask, this package delivers respiratory protection for Law enforcement, Corrections and First responders.

products.title: B1309 Cartridge
products.body_html:
The B1309 Cartridge is a NIOSH Certified high-performance industrial filter designed for use with the iEvac® E500 Escape Hood. It provides protection against a broad spectrum of toxic industrial gases, vapors, and particulates—making it a critical component for emergency escape in hazardous environments.

Featuring a universal screw-in connection, the B1309 respirator cartridge is easily replaceable and can be mounted on either side of the hood for optimal comfort and visibility. Whether used in chemical plants, manufacturing facilities, or industrial maintenance operations, these respirator filters deliver reliable respiratory protection when it matters most.

products.title: B1309-4 | Pack of 4 Cartridges
products.body_html:
The B1309-4 (Pack of 4 Cartridges) includes four NIOSH Certified high-efficiency filters engineered for use with the iEvac® E500 Escape Hood. These industrial-grade respirator cartridges are designed to protect against a wide range of toxic gases, harmful vapors, and airborne particulates, making them essential for emergency preparedness in high-risk environments.

Each of these respirator filters/cartridges feature a universal screw-in design that allows easy installation on either side of the hood, enhancing both comfort and field of view. Ideal for chemical plants, industrial facilities, and maintenance operations, the B1309-4 respirator cartridge multipack offers dependable respiratory protection where hazardous exposure is a constant concern.

products.title: B1318 Pleated HEPA Filter
products.body_html:
The B1318 Pleated HEPA Gas Mask Filter offers robust protection against biological agents, aerosols, and toxic powders with a greater than 99.97% filtration efficiency. Its reusable design, universal NATO Din 40 connection, and 12-year shelf life make it a reliable choice.

Paired with the E600 HEPA Filter Mask, this package delivers respiratory protection for Law enforcement, Corrections and First responders.

products.title: B1318-4 | Pack of 4 Pleated HEPA Filters
products.body_html:

This pack of four ensures economical and continuous access to critical respiratory protection.

When combined with the E600 HEPA Filter Mask, these filters equip Law Enforcement, Corrections, and First Responders with essential respiratory protection in unpredictable environments.

products.title: E500 Escape Hood Plug
products.body_html:
The Escape Hood Plug is designed to securely seal the unused filter port of the E500 Escape Hood, preventing contaminants from entering and maintaining an airtight seal. Easy to install with a simple clockwise turn, it enhances the hood’s versatility and ensures reliable protection when using a single cartridge.

The Escape Hood Plug comes standard with the E500 Escape Hood. If lost or damaged, you can easily get a replacement here to maintain your hood’s integrity and protection.

products.title: E600 Gas Mask
products.body_html:
The E600 Gas Mask is a full face gas mask designed for Law Enforcement, Corrections, and First Responders protecting them against Tear Gas, Pepper Spray and other Toxic Powders. The tactical gas mask's visor provides robust, impact-resistant protection with advanced anti-fog technology for clear, distortion-free panoramic views. Its scratch-resistant design ensures long-lasting clarity and compatibility with weapon sights, making it ideal for both safety and performance.

Paired with the B1318 Hepa Mask Filter or B1305 Riot Control Canister, this package delivers respiratory protection for Law enforcement, Corrections and First responders.

products.title: E600 Optional Spectacle Frame
products.body_html:

Lightweight and durable, this frame offers a comfortable solution for maintaining visual acuity and safety while wearing the mask.

Paired with the E600 military grade gas mask, these spectacles deliver comprehensive respiratory protection for Law enforcement, Corrections and First responders.

products.title: E600 Respirator Plug
products.body_html:

Easy to install with a simple clockwise turn, it enhances the mask’s versatility and ensures reliable protection when using a single filter or canister.

The Respirator Plug comes standard with the E600 full face gas mask. If lost or damaged, you can easily get a replacement here to maintain your Gas Mask’s integrity and protection.

products.title: E670 Custom Tactical Gas Mask Pouch
products.body_html:
The E670 Custom Tactical Gas Mask Pouch is a rugged, purpose-built storage solution designed to securely house the E600 Gas Mask. Crafted from 1000 denier nylon for maximum durability, this pouch ensures the mask is protected from damage while remaining quickly accessible in high-risk scenarios where readiness is essential.

Featuring tactical mounting options, the E670 can be belt-worn and fixed around the leg or gear-mounted, adapting easily to field, military, or law enforcement environments. Its wide, easy-access opening allows for rapid deployment of the gas mask, making it an indispensable accessory for operators who demand speed, reliability, and convenience.

products.title: iEvac® E200 Demo Hood
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E200 Demo Hood is a non-functional training version of the iEvac® E900 Smoke/Fire Hood, designed specifically for demonstration, drills, and hands-on instruction. Visually identical to the certified iEvac® E900 smoke respirator, the E200 allows users to become familiar with proper donning techniques and emergency procedures without using a live, operational smoke escape hood.

Ideal for training programs across government agencies, correctional facilities, aviation as an airplane smoke hood, industrial settings, and corporate safety teams, the iEvac® E200 helps build confidence and readiness through realistic practice. It replicates the size, fit, and feel of the E900, including features such as the universal fit for all head sizes, compatibility with eyeglasses and facial hair, and the clear visor for unobstructed vision.

While it does not provide actual respiratory protection, the iEvac® E200 Demo Hood plays a critical role in emergency preparedness by enabling safe, repeated training use. It’s an essential component of any safety program aimed at ensuring fast, effective response when every second counts.

Used for demonstration purposes only. Not to be used for emergency evacuation.

*Due to the nature of this product, this product cannot be returned.

products.title: iEvac® E270 Nylon Carry-Pouch
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E270 Nylon Carry-Pouch is a rugged, purpose-built storage solution designed to securely house the iEvac® E900 Smoke/Fire Hood. This durable carry pouch provides protection while ensuring fast, reliable access in emergency situations where every moment counts.

Compact and highly portable, the E270 features reinforced belt loops for flexible carrying or mounting options, ideal for use in industrial sites, vehicles, or public safety environments. The easy opening allows for quick deployment of the iEvac® E900 smoke hood, keeping critical personal protection within immediate reach.

Whether worn on a belt, or attached to gear, the iEvac® E270 Nylon Carry-Pouch is an essential accessory for preparedness and quick access to your E900 smoke mask, mobility, and rapid response.

products.title: iEvac® E305 Single Wall-mounting Rack
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E305 Single Wall-Mounting Rack is a compact, high-visibility storage solution designed to keep one iEvac® E900 Smoke/Fire Hood readily accessible in critical environments. Crafted from durable, powder-coated metal in a bold red finish, the E305 ensures that life-saving smoke hoods are always easy to locate and deploy when seconds matter.

This minimalist, open-faced rack securely holds a single iEvac® unit and mounts quickly to any wall surface with just two screws, offering a reliable and space-efficient storage option for offices, transit areas, industrial sites, or residential settings where emergency escape hoods are a necessity. Its low-profile design keeps the hood in plain sight while protecting it from unnecessary handling or obstruction.

Ideal for emergency preparedness and fast response deployment, the iEvac® E305 Wall-Mounting Rack is the essential part of every fire evacuation checklist and combines convenience, visibility, and peace of mind in one streamlined solution.

products.title: iEvac® E312 Metal Wall Mounting Cabinet with Window and Lock
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E312 Metal Wall-Mounting Cabinet with Window and Lock is a durable, tamper-resistant storage solution designed to hold up to 12 iEvac® E900 Smoke/Fire Hoods in a single, centralized location. Constructed from sturdy white-painted metal, this cabinet ensures that E900 smoke masks are protected, organized, and instantly visible through its clear front window.

Ideal for workplaces, public facilities, and emergency preparedness zones, the E312 is equipped with a secure lock and includes two keys, tamper-proof tape, and all necessary mounting hardware for easy installation. The lockable door prevents unauthorized access to protective gear while allowing fast retrieval during emergencies.

With its clean design, high storage capacity, and prominent visibility, the iEvac® E312 Wall Cabinet is the perfect solution for organizations seeking accessible, secure, and compliant storage for emergency escape hoods.

products.title: iEvac® E500-1 | NIOSH Certified E500 Hood, B1309 Filter and E570 Nylon Carry Case
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E500-1 combines the reliable performance of the E500 Industrial Escape Hood / Respirator Mask with the B1309 Filter and rugged E570 Nylon Carry Case, offering a complete, ready-to-deploy solution for emergency protection in industrial environments.

Certified under NIOSH 42 CFR Part 84 (TC-84A-9746 | TC-84A-9843), the reusable E500 hood is a chemical respirator made from a soft, transparent material and features a wide, anti-fog visor for distortion-free vision. Its universal filter connection allows side-mount placement for added comfort and visibility.

The included B1309 respirator filter provides protection against a wide spectrum of toxic industrial threats including Chlorine, Hydrogen Sulfide, Sulfur Dioxide, Organic Vapors, and more.

The kit is completed with the iEvac® E570 Nylon Carry Case - padded and built from durable 1,000 denier nylon. It can be belt-mounted using loops and snaps or wall-mounted via its integrated D-ring for quick access in high-risk areas.

products.title: iEvac® E500-2 | NIOSH Certified E500 Hood, B1304 P100 Filter and E570 Nylon Carry Case
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E500-2 combines the proven performance of the E500 Industrial Escape Hood with the certified B1304 P100 Filter and rugged E570 Nylon Carry Case delivering a complete, ready-to-deploy solution for emergency escape.

Certified under NIOSH 42 CFR Part 84 (TC-84A- 9843 | TC-84A-9843), the E500 hood provides immediate respiratory and eye protection with a wide, anti-fog visor and a soft, transparent construction for comfort and visibility. Paired with the B1304 P100 Filter, it offers greater than 99.97% efficiency against particulates (P100 Level), aerosols, and toxic powders, ensuring maximum protection in high-risk industrial environments.

products.title: iEvac® E570 Nylon Carry Case
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E570 Nylon Carry Case is a durable storage solution designed specifically for securely housing the iEvac® E500-1 (E500 Mask Hood and B1309 Cartridge) Escape Respirator Hood. Constructed from rugged 1,000 denier nylon, this padded case ensures reliable protection and quick access in emergency environments where speed and accessibility are vital.

Equipped with belt loops, snaps, and an integrated D-ring, the E570 carry pouch can be worn on a belt or mounted on a wall for versatile deployment across industrial, commercial, or safety-critical settings. Its wide zipper opening allows for fast retrieval of the hood, making it an essential accessory for preparedness and rapid response.

products.title: iEvac® E900 Smoke Hood / Fire Escape Mask
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E900 Smoke/Fire Hood is the only American Certified smoke/fire hood designed to provide reliable personal protection during emergencies involving fire, smoke, toxic gases, and even terrorist threats. Used by government agencies, correctional facilities, pilots, industrial workers, corporate offices, and families around the world, the iEvac® E900 fire hood offers critical protection when every second counts.

It protects against carbon monoxide, the leading cause of fire-related deaths as well as a wide range of hazardous gases such as ammonia, chlorine, hydrogen sulfide, formaldehyde, and more. It also shields against biological agents and radioactive particles through a high-efficiency HEPA filter. The iEvac® E900 fire mask is quick and easy to use, fits all head sizes, and can be worn with eyeglasses, beards, or long hair. With a clear field of vision, twin filters for easier breathing, and compact packaging, it’s designed for rapid response in high-stress situations.

No maintenance or fit testing is required, and each unit has a shelf life of 5.5 years. Whether at home, in the office, in transit, or at sea, the iEvac® E900 as one of the widely used smoke masks helps ensure a safer, faster evacuation in the event of an emergency.

*Due to the American certification, this product cannot be returned.

products.title: iEvac® NIOSH Certified E500 Escape Hood
products.body_html:
The iEvac® E500 Industrial Escape Hood is built for industrial environments where fast, reliable protection from toxic gases, vapors, and particulates is critical. Constructed from a soft, transparent material, the mask hood offers a wide, distortion-free field of view with anti-fog coating for enhanced visibility in emergency scenarios.

Certified under NIOSH 42 CFR Part 84 (TC-84A-9746 | TC-84A-9843), the reusable E500 features a single, easily replaceable mask filter connection with universal side-mount placement for user comfort. No fit testing, no maintenance, and no medical evaluation required—making it a cost-effective, ready-to-use solution.
